note: Texas counties have no general zoning power, so Wilson County publishes no district layer. Its largest city, Floresville, shows zoning only in an ArcGIS web map (Floresville Zoning 2026_2, owner Floresville1) whose data is embedded feature collections, with no queryable FeatureServer or MapServer. The county's gis.wilson-co.com Wilson County Zoning MapServer is Wilson County, North Carolina, not Texas.
